name: nl-vat-return
description: Use this skill whenever asked to prepare, review, or classify transactions for a Netherlands VAT return (OB aangifte / btw-aangifte) for a self-employed individual or small business in the Netherlands, for tax year 2026. Trigger on phrases like "prepare OB aangifte", "Dutch VAT return", "BTW aangifte", "aangifte omzetbelasting", "classify transactions for Dutch VAT", "KOR", "suppletie", "opgaaf ICP", "btw verlegd", "Dutch VAT rate 2026", or any request involving Netherlands VAT filing. Covers the rates (21%, 9%, 0%) and the 2026 move of short-stay accommodation (logies) from 9% to 21%; the small business scheme (KOR, EUR 20,000) and the EU scheme (EU-KOR, EUR 100,000); periods and deadlines; the boxes 1a to 5b; reverse charge (verleggingsregeling); private use of a business car with its cap; revision of investment goods (herziening); the ICP listing; corrections (suppletie) and the EUR 1,000 threshold; penalties and tax interest (belastingrente, 5% in 2026).
